note: Definitions and empty execution fields. NOT_RUN is not a failure result or a pass. Existing evidence must be revalidated for the implementation candidate.

cases.title: Current branch and instructions
cases.given: The repository and existing PR10 work are available.
cases.when: Inspect current refs, dirty work and relevant instructions before edits.
cases.then: Record actual main/candidate/base relation and preserve unrelated changes; use the current verified implementation, not an assumed historical branch.
cases.evidence_required: Baseline record with SHAs, worktree decision and relevant instruction paths.

cases.title: Reproducible locked setup
cases.given: A clean supported Python/Node environment exists.
cases.when: Install with the existing lockfiles and run a bounded offline smoke.
cases.then: Setup works or a precise environment blocker is recorded; no automatic unrelated dependency upgrade and no paid provider call.
cases.evidence_required: Actual commands, environment versions, exit results and any bounded setup fix.

cases.title: Traceability and conditional scope
cases.given: This PRD, catalog and plan are loaded.
cases.when: Map requirements to existing modules, tests and stories.
cases.then: Every applicable requirement has an owner/story/evidence target; optional integration is deferred unless G6 is approved; existing functionality is not rebuilt merely to fill a checklist.
cases.evidence_required: Current traceability map and scope decision.

cases.title: Delayed affirmative intent regression
cases.given: The exact synthetic failing fixtures from the audit exist.
cases.when: Run the classifier before and after the narrow temporal-negation correction.
cases.then: The previously failing present/future-intent fixtures route to support; the pre-fix reproduction and reason for change are preserved.
cases.evidence_required: Fixture IDs, pre-fix failure, post-fix result and explained diff.

cases.title: Paired denial and context controls
cases.given: Paired genuine denials and reviewed historical/quotation controls are predeclared.
cases.when: Run the same classifier changes over the control set.
cases.then: Expected routes remain correct; no broad removal of negation or blanket support classification; ambiguous fixtures have explicit expected behavior and review rationale.
cases.evidence_required: Case-by-case expected/actual routes, including any unresolved ambiguity.

cases.title: Real entry points suppress side effects
cases.given: Instrumented candidate/search clients and supported API entry points are available.
cases.when: Submit required support fixtures through the actual reflection/chat paths.
cases.then: Support response uses deterministic behavior; no candidate/judge/search call occurs for those paths and no inappropriate activity continuation is persisted.
cases.validation: API integration with captured fake clients and real local persistence where meaningful.
cases.evidence_required: Call counts, response state and persistence assertions by entry point.

cases.title: No unsupported safety claim
cases.given: The bounded English regression set passes.
cases.when: Review UI/help/README and evaluation reporting.
cases.then: Scope stays English and research beta; passing fixtures are not described as general safety accuracy, clinical validation or crisis-care capability.
cases.evidence_required: Current disclosure/case-study excerpts with exact evidence scope.

cases.title: Exact save without model availability
cases.given: An owner has a fictional draft and model/search clients are disabled or failing.
cases.when: Save then retrieve from authoritative persistence.
cases.then: Exact submitted text is returned; Saved appears only after a valid receipt; provider call count is zero.
cases.evidence_required: Persisted fixture equality, save receipt and zero-call assertion.

cases.title: Navigation and newer typing
cases.given: A save is delayed while newer text is entered or the user navigates away.
cases.when: Resolve the earlier save and return/refresh the original tab.
cases.then: Newer typing is preserved; old replies do not navigate the user unexpectedly or replace newer text; account-scoped tab recovery matches current contract.
cases.validation: Browser test with controlled response order.
cases.evidence_required: Before/after draft, receipt and route-state assertions.

cases.title: Uncertain save and receipt replay
cases.given: The server persists a save but the response is lost.
cases.when: Retry the same logical save using its existing receipt.
cases.then: Exactly the original logical save is recovered without a duplicate entry; unrelated fresh intent remains distinct.
cases.evidence_required: Persisted row count/identity and receipt replay trace.

cases.title: Conflicts, account switches and erasure
cases.given: Two tabs have competing revisions and an old request is in flight.
cases.when: Commit a newer revision, switch account or erase data before the old response returns.
cases.then: Stale mutation/response is rejected or ignored per contract; no silent overwrite, cross-account resurfacing or erased-data resurrection.
cases.validation: Controlled concurrency and browser isolation tests.
cases.evidence_required: Expected conflict/fence behavior and owner-specific final state.

cases.title: Simple mode remains independent
cases.given: AI/search are available but the user selects Simple or only writes.
cases.when: Complete the supported scripted path.
cases.then: No model/search request occurs; mode labels are accurate and existing Simple/local-timer semantics are preserved.
cases.evidence_required: Zero-call proof and actual resulting mode/state.

cases.title: Explicit owned-entry sharing
cases.given: Owners A/B have distinct entries and chat can be linked or unlinked.
cases.when: Try an unlinked chat, an explicit A link and an attempted B link.
cases.then: Unlinked chat receives no journal content; only explicitly selected owned content is shared; cross-owner reference is rejected before provider use.
cases.evidence_required: Captured provider payload and rejected cross-owner request.

cases.title: Separate external-search approval
cases.given: AI consent is granted but search consent is absent.
cases.when: Request a resource suggestion, then separately grant topic-search consent.
cases.then: No external search before its own approval; afterward only the disclosed topic fields leave; raw journal/history is absent; unavailable search offers the documented alternative.
cases.evidence_required: Consent transitions, approved field allowlist and zero-call denied path.

cases.title: Revocation and provider failures
cases.given: A consented request is pending and the provider may timeout, refuse or return invalid output.
cases.when: Revoke, erase or switch account while it is pending; also exercise each terminal provider failure.
cases.then: No new unauthorized dispatch or stale persistence; already transmitted calls are not falsely claimed recalled; saved writing/report survives; fallback is labeled and never counted as AI success.
cases.validation: Fault ordering, schema validation and UI test.
cases.evidence_required: Request/result fence assertions and truthful error/fallback state.

cases.title: Server lifecycle and optimistic concurrency
cases.given: An owned modern activity has known session/conversation revisions.
cases.when: Exercise start, pause, resume, finish_early, expire, stop and decline, including stale/repeated receipts.
cases.then: Allowed transitions use server time and expected revisions; invalid/stale commands cannot overwrite canonical state; replay does not duplicate effects; no invented reset path.
cases.evidence_required: Transition/receipt evidence and final canonical revisions.

cases.title: Timer is not participation
cases.given: An activity starts and later reaches its deadline.
cases.when: Expire it without a participant report.
cases.then: It reaches awaiting_report as appropriate; no completed participation, positive outcome or Journey success is fabricated.
cases.validation: Deterministic clock test and UI assertion.
cases.evidence_required: Session and Journey/report state before/after deadline.

cases.title: Report persists before follow-up
cases.given: A user reports completed, partial, not_tried or stopped.
cases.when: Save the report and force the optional follow-up to fail or be retried.
cases.then: The exact participation report remains; skipped ratings stay unknown; follow-up retries do not duplicate the report or imply activity performance.
cases.evidence_required: Saved report, retry behavior and honest follow-up state.

cases.title: Cross-owner and hosted-auth boundary
cases.given: Owners A/B have journals, conversations and activities; auth can fail.
cases.when: Attempt unauthorized list/get/change/export and service-outage paths.
cases.then: No B content or mutation is available to A; owner comes from auth; production does not fall back to a development identity; responses follow existing non-enumerating behavior.
cases.validation: API/RLS tests plus scoped hosted disposable checks.
cases.evidence_required: Two-owner results and actual auth-outage behavior.

cases.title: Export correctness
cases.given: A has known supported fictional records and B has different records.
cases.when: Export A's saved data.
cases.then: The export parses, includes expected supported A records, excludes B/secrets and clearly states scope and any intentionally excluded provider/external copies.
cases.evidence_required: Redacted schema/count comparison, not raw personal contents.

cases.title: Erasure and in-flight resurrection
cases.given: A has saved data and delayed writes/results; B remains active.
cases.when: Erase A's saved data and release delayed responses.
cases.then: A's supported data and new stage-owned data are removed/fenced; stale work cannot recreate them; B is unchanged; A's sign-in identity remains; replay is safe.
cases.validation: Repository/DB race tests and hosted disposable lifecycle.
cases.evidence_required: Count/epoch/fence assertions and signed-in state after data erasure.

cases.title: Sensitive-data canaries
cases.given: Fictional canary text/token values are placed in controlled inputs/errors.
cases.when: Exercise validation, provider failure, telemetry and evidence generation.
cases.then: No journal/chat/action title, credential or raw sensitive payload is present in operational logs, error summaries or public evidence; intentional encrypted backups remain outside Git/evaluation artifacts.
cases.evidence_required: Canary checks and documented content-free evidence fields.

cases.title: Unavailable until actual prerequisites
cases.given: Closure flag/config/migration/hosted gate is missing or incomplete.
cases.when: Inspect capability and attempt account closure.
cases.then: Production closure stays unavailable without claiming completion; after verified recovery and compatible migration, the exact staged build may be configured for disposable smoke. Data erasure stays separate. No production promotion before the hosted gate.
cases.validation: Configuration tests and hosted gate review.
cases.evidence_required: Capability/readiness evidence, migration identity and blocker if pending.

cases.title: Fresh sign-in and operation-bound receipt
cases.given: A closure request has a bearer identity and controllable AMR/receipt fields.
cases.when: Try fresh sign-in, refresh-only old sign-in, wrong owner, stale/invalid receipt and caller user_id.
cases.then: The initial request requires the intended authenticated owner with real sign-in within 5 minutes and exact confirmation/UUID4/256-bit receipt. Token refresh is insufficient. Existing pending/completed closure may continue via the valid 15-minute receipt after Auth deletion invalidates the session; a valid other-owner bearer is rejected. Expired receipt with unresolved post-deletion completion requires operator reconciliation. Admin credentials remain server-only.
cases.validation: Local auth/receipt fault tests plus actual hosted freshness smoke.
cases.evidence_required: Case results and exact operation binding, with no secrets retained.

cases.title: Partial failure and concurrent writes
cases.given: Closure can pause before/after Admin deletion while writes race.
cases.when: Inject each supported uncertain/failure ordering and retry with the valid receipt.
cases.then: Pending/complete markers block A writes; B works; 204 is withheld until identity and dependent rows are absent; uncertainty remains truthful; no deleted data is restored.
cases.evidence_required: Closure ledger state, dependent-row checks and response transitions.

cases.title: Actual disposable hosted lifecycle
cases.given: Real recovery, compatible migration, staged deployment and scoped credentials are ready.
cases.when: Run the existing hosted smoke on two newly tagged fictional accounts, with verified IDs and cleanup scope.
cases.then: Actual Auth/DB behavior and >5-minute refresh-only rejection are verified; fixture accounts are cleaned as authorized; local fakes are not substituted; rollback preserves guards.
cases.evidence_required: Exact deployment/schema report, account fixture identifiers protected, cleanup result and timestamp.

cases.title: Live encrypted export within guards
cases.given: Secure credentials/passphrase, Docker/GPG and the approved source guard are ready.
cases.when: Run the existing live export procedure through its secure input mechanism.
cases.then: A consistent intended-source snapshot is encrypted before disk write; size/version/dependency guards hold; no secret/content leaks into agent logs or Git. Enforce PostgreSQL 17 and 128 MiB guards; storage-object/Vault dependencies stop the procedure.
cases.validation: Actual guarded operation; fictional dry run is separate.
cases.evidence_required: Content-free source identity, archive digest/location reference, snapshot time and encryption verification.

cases.title: Isolated local restore verification
cases.given: An actual encrypted export is available.
cases.when: Restore only into the runbook's unique disposable isolated target and run its invariants.
cases.then: Decryption/schema/count/integrity checks pass without touching production; record duration and coverage; do not claim hosted Auth recovery/PITR.
cases.evidence_required: Verification receipt, target-isolation evidence, durations and cleanup result.

cases.title: Deletion reconciliation and fail-closed reopening
cases.given: A backup predates erasure/closure and deletion history may be incomplete.
cases.when: Rehearse recovery with complete and incomplete post-snapshot history using fictional fixtures.
cases.then: Complete history removes later-deleted data before access; incomplete/unprovable history leaves recovered data inaccessible; no invented independent deletion-ledger claim.
cases.validation: Controlled restore/deletion drill plus actual process review.
cases.evidence_required: Decision record and demonstrated access quarantine.

cases.title: Cadence, generations and honest recovery scope
cases.given: One or more actual verified generations exist.
cases.when: Review retention and the recovery runbook.
cases.then: Manual weekly/pre-change cadence and three verified generations are accurately reported; zero/missing generations remain visible; actual latest snapshot defines exposure; no automatic-backup or full-DR claim without evidence. Three generations is a rolling target, not three duplicate pre-release runs; never displace the sole good generation with a failed one.
cases.evidence_required: Generation inventory, retention/cleanup procedure, latest verification and known limits.

cases.title: Frontend origin and CSP agreement
cases.given: Default and explicitly permitted distinct frontend/backend auth origins are configured.
cases.when: Build/serve the exported frontend and exercise browser auth network destinations.
cases.then: The actual permitted origin is allowed, or unsupported mismatch fails build clearly; no wildcard introduced; disallowed origins remain blocked.
cases.evidence_required: Two configuration results and actual response CSP.

cases.title: Same-byte script policy and regression
cases.given: The exported page is served under the updated policy.
cases.when: Check allowed scripts, injected/unapproved script and relevant rolling/static cache behavior.
cases.then: Intended scripts work and unapproved script remains blocked; hashes apply to the same bytes served; no broad unsafe relaxation.
cases.evidence_required: Policy/hash/assertion output tied to build.

cases.title: Plain public phone/SMS target
cases.given: The public information component is rendered.
cases.when: Inspect phone/SMS href and open the link chooser on a supported device without initiating a call.
cases.then: Displayed number and target agree; no HTTP attribution query in the phone target; no test call is placed.
cases.validation: Static/component check and manual device inspection.
cases.evidence_required: Sanitized target and device/browser observation.

cases.title: New source freeze and original controls
cases.given: Inference-relevant repairs are complete and old bundles exist.
cases.when: Compare source/packet, prepare a new named bundle and update the wrapper explicitly.
cases.then: Old bundles remain immutable; new hashes bind repaired source/prompts/catalog/runner/lockfiles/requests; 100 cases/50 families/40-60 split retained; route mix recomputed; ledger path/cap preserved. Authoritative ledger history survives worktree changes; frozen absolute path must match actual runner ledger, with no fresh allowance.
cases.validation: Prepare/guard tests and reviewed freeze diff.
cases.evidence_required: Manifest, source/packet comparison and explicit wrapper target.

cases.title: Cost, routing and non-repeat execution guards
cases.given: Frozen runner can be exercised with fake endpoints/accounting failures.
cases.when: Test unavailable ZDR/structured endpoint, identity mismatch, unresolved cost, budget breach, transport interruption and existing result file.
cases.then: No forbidden/extra call proceeds; no fallback, ledger reset, duplicate case/stage attempt or rerun of an existing bundle; USD10 total includes failed attempts.
cases.validation: Existing evaluator-control tests with failure injection.
cases.evidence_required: Accounting/call-count traces and stop reasons without credentials.

cases.title: Predeclared release policy
cases.given: Reserved outputs have not been viewed.
cases.when: Record PRD Section 9 thresholds, expected-route completeness, human sample rule and decision algorithm before execution.
cases.then: Policy is versioned and unambiguous; it is labeled new, not an existing runner gate; candidate report completion alone cannot produce PASS. Mean population and family weighting are distinct from all-expected-normal case denominator N; empty populations cannot pass.
cases.validation: Decision-validator unit examples and policy review.
cases.evidence_required: Timestamped/versioned policy and examples where poor/critical/incomplete results fail or block.

cases.title: Actual run and full denominators
cases.given: Current session has paid-run authorization, secure credentials and a valid fresh bundle.
cases.when: Execute the frozen candidate/judge run once under its existing controls.
cases.then: All planned cases/statuses and charges are accounted for; exceptions remain visible; no historical W/L/T substitution; missing/invalid results block qualification; actual models/providers/latencies recorded.
cases.validation: Actual paid run; no mocked substitute.
cases.evidence_required: Immutable results, ledger reconciliation, exact source/provider identity and generated report.

cases.title: Independent human review and quality decision
cases.given: Actual run exists and a real independent reviewer is available.
cases.when: Grade the preselected 20 outputs blinded to judge scores/model identity, then inspect support/flagged cases and apply Section 9.
cases.then: All 20 prespecified cases remain in the human denominator; blind grades precede adjudication. Apply Section 9 exactly: confirmed critical failure FAILS this candidate, indeterminate concern BLOCKS, only documented unsupported judge flags may clear with original grades preserved. Human review cannot repair invalid/missing model results. Frozen runner reports stay unchanged; attach separate human/decision records.
cases.validation: Human review plus deterministic decision computation.
cases.evidence_required: Review sheet, sample-selection rule, unique reviewed counts, rationales and decision.

cases.title: Holdout discipline and claims
cases.given: Results may be weak, incomplete or inconclusive.
cases.when: Review follow-up changes and publication text.
cases.then: No tuning/repeated run of reserved cases to manufacture a pass; revised development and genuinely new reserved evidence are planned when needed; AI-judged, human, hosted and clinical status stay distinct.
cases.evidence_required: Preserved negative results, change history and accurately scoped claims.

cases.title: Required current-candidate verification
cases.given: Applicable changes are ready.
cases.when: Run focused checks, then the repository's required release/CI checks once for the candidate.
cases.then: All required checks pass or the candidate remains gated; real PostgreSQL checks use a proven disposable target; skipped/mocked checks are disclosed; generated API contracts match.
cases.evidence_required: SHAs, command/exit outputs, test IDs, environment and skips.

cases.title: Final evidence manifest and hosted identity
cases.given: Source and artifacts are finalized and authorized deployment checks are available.
cases.when: Generate/verify the final manifest and inspect the actual deployment.
cases.then: Every claim binds the relevant source/inference/schema/environment; hosted ID is observed rather than assumed; historical manifests remain labeled; no final edits silently invalidate evidence.
cases.evidence_required: Current release record with CI/model/recovery/hosted evidence separately linked.

cases.title: Rollback and support procedure
cases.given: A candidate, previous application and additive data guards exist.
cases.when: Rehearse/inspect rollback and one provider/auth/save failure support scenario.
cases.then: Affected optional capability can be disabled; data/closure guards and deletion history preserved; no rollback resurrects records or replays external writes; support does not require journal content.
cases.evidence_required: Rollback target, exact procedure, observed scope and unresolved limits.

cases.title: Accessible core paths
cases.given: Core pages are available on the candidate.
cases.when: Run keyboard-only, visible-focus, labels/status announcement, 320px layout and 200% zoom checks on the three tasks.
cases.then: Critical actions and recovery remain operable/readable; no clipped required controls or keyboard trap; scoped defects corrected and browser coverage reported.
cases.validation: Manual inspection plus meaningful existing browser checks.
cases.evidence_required: Checklist with device/browser/build and observed issues.

cases.title: Five real standardized sessions
cases.given: Five adults have agreed to observed fictional-data sessions.
cases.when: Run the same 5/7/6-minute task caps and neutral instructions; record assistance/stops.
cases.then: Five real participant records exist with familiarity, version, first exposure/retest, outcome/time and mode; no coaching is counted unassisted; no synthetic observations.
cases.evidence_required: Pseudonymous task sheet, consent accounting and raw counts.

cases.title: First-use task and comprehension gates
cases.given: The five sessions are complete on the assessed candidate or explicitly separated versions.
cases.when: Apply PRD thresholds and repair repeated friction.
cases.then: 5/5 unassisted save/retrieve and >=4/5 chosen-mode reflection/action with persisted retrieval meet the first-use gate. All 5 ultimately complete export/open/erasure and understand the sign-in boundary; initial assistance stays visible. Simple is not counted as AI. Functional privacy failure or repeated unresolved navigation confusion blocks expansion.
cases.validation: Observed task scoring and separate retest.
cases.evidence_required: Initial and retest tables, requested/actual modes, comprehension results and fix decisions.

cases.title: Opt-in and minimal event allowlist
cases.applies_when: Only if product research telemetry is selected; manual-only measurement may mark this instrumentation criterion NOT_APPLICABLE with a scope record. Consent/withdrawal/retention for real notes/mappings remain required under UX/PILOT/OBS-03.
cases.given: Research telemetry is optional and a fictional canary fixture exists.
cases.when: Decline consent, enable it, generate events and inspect the exported fields.
cases.then: No research events before consent or after revocation; app works without telemetry; no backfill; only allowed pseudonymous fields; no journal/action/mood/token/IP content.
cases.validation: Boundary and payload tests plus disclosure review.
cases.evidence_required: Consent version/state, allowed-field schema and canary results.

cases.title: Metric semantics and deduplication
cases.given: Fixtures include retries, Simple fallback, timer expiry, zero activity, missing events, late activation and changed builds.
cases.when: Calculate pilot metrics from those fixtures.
cases.then: Retries do not multiply workflows; timer/export is not participation; mature/partial/unknown denominators are distinct; cost includes unsuccessful cohort attempts; zero denominator is undefined; mode/build preserved.
cases.validation: Meaningful calculation examples against explicit expected totals.
cases.evidence_required: Metric definitions, fixture totals and reproducible calculation.

cases.title: Withdrawal and retention enforcement
cases.given: A participant has consented events, notes and contact mapping.
cases.when: Withdraw or expire the declared retention window.
cases.then: Collection stops; linked research events/notes are removed within 24h of withdrawal; raw research records/mapping deleted no later than 30 days after cohort close; summaries recomputed; product/provider retention not misrepresented.
cases.validation: Test-clock removal and actual operating procedure.
cases.evidence_required: Deletion job/manual procedure, dry-run result and published retention wording.

cases.title: Fresh enrollment and mature windows
cases.given: Five session participants may accept or decline a new pilot.
cases.when: Record invitations/enrollment and observe each 168-hour window.
cases.then: Actual enrolled/withdrawn/opted-out/fully observed/partial counts reconcile; five sessions are not assumed five pilot users; no daily-use pressure; zero-use participants remain in eligible denominators.
cases.evidence_required: Consent ledger and complete per-participant window accounting.

cases.title: Real-use report and stop rules
cases.given: A released candidate is used voluntarily.
cases.when: Collect bounded support/usefulness observations and inspect critical issues.
cases.then: Report real positive/negative/non-use results and missingness; isolation, confirmed-save loss, erased-data resurrection or severe routing issue stops affected use/expansion; no clinical/causal/adoption exaggeration.
cases.evidence_required: Cohort report, issue log, build changes and actual stop/resume decisions.

cases.title: Next-investment decision
cases.given: The planned five-person enrolled cohort has complete accounting.
cases.when: Apply the predeclared useful-outcome plus later-day-return rule.
cases.then: Continue only with >=3 of the same 5 enrolled participants each meeting both specific-usefulness and eligible later-day-return conditions, with no unresolved P0. Record met/not met/inconclusive/incomplete cohort and unknowns; no denominator changes to force success.
cases.evidence_required: Counts meeting each/both conditions, unknowns and continue/simplify/stop rationale.

cases.title: Discovery and provider feasibility
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: Core blockers are resolved and an external-task need is being considered.
cases.when: Review at least two actual matching user problems, select one destination/adapter and assess official account/API contract and access feasibility; any disposable spike requires its own scoped authorization.
cases.then: G6a scope decision records one bounded need and feasible implementation path. Permission scope is described honestly; no extra adapter/two-way sync. Implementation may proceed after scope approval; actual provider/acceptance proof is G6b, not a prerequisite for starting the build.
cases.validation: Discovery, official-contract/access review and optional scoped feasibility spike.
cases.evidence_required: Scope decision, official provider contracts, chosen account type and constraints.

cases.title: Owned approved immutable payload
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: An owned activity and current connection/revisions exist.
cases.when: Submit missing approval, wrong owner, stale revisions, unknown fields and a valid reviewed snapshot. Force a failure during transaction acceptance.
cases.then: Only the valid owned ActivitySession.id and expected activity/conversation/connection revisions are accepted; owner derived from auth; exact title/minimal fields frozen; no journal/history included or catalog mutation. Owner/revision/fence validation, local/semantic deduplication, frozen approval and outbox insertion commit atomically. Forced rollback creates no accepted intent or provider write. Only exact reviewed title, optional due fields and disclosed opaque correlation leave; no extra journal/chat context.
cases.evidence_required: Allowed/denied cases and captured exact adapter payload.

cases.title: Local replay and two-tab duplicate guard
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: One activity has a pending or succeeded export.
cases.when: Double click, replay the same key with same/changed payload, and submit a new key from another tab.
cases.then: Same intent returns same receipt; changed key payload conflicts; cross-tab semantic guard prevents another active/uncertain/succeeded export for the same activity/account/list; no remote exactly-once claim.
cases.evidence_required: Receipt IDs, row uniqueness and adapter call counts.

cases.title: Lost response and expired worker lease
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: Provider creation may succeed before the response or worker is lost.
cases.when: Race two workers for the same queued intent; drop a response or crash after the durable dispatch claim, expire its lease and release a stale worker result.
cases.then: Queued-to-sending atomically claims one attempt against current erasure epoch/connection generation. Only the valid claim dispatches; stale workers cannot overwrite newer state. Crash/lease expiry after claim is uncertain unless non-transmission is affirmatively proved; no automatic repeat-create/reset-to-queued. No DB transaction stays open across network I/O.
cases.evidence_required: State/lease trace and zero additional POST assertions.

cases.title: Positive-only reconciliation
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: An uncertain intent has an opaque correlation marker.
cases.when: Exercise one match, multiple matches, zero matches, partial pages, moved task and unavailable credentials.
cases.then: One exact positive match can establish creation; every other ambiguous result stays unresolved or reports anomaly; no negative lookup permits repeat POST; no silent remote deletion.
cases.validation: Adapter reconciliation tests plus real marker write/read probe.
cases.evidence_required: Full marker/correlation behavior and bounded read/call trace.

cases.title: Bounded known-safe retry
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: Dispatcher has a predeclared approval lifetime and finite retry budget.
cases.when: Return documented throttling, verified pre-send failure, ambiguous 5xx, timeout and expired approval.
cases.then: Only demonstrably non-creating failures can retry; Retry-After respected; expired approvals stop; SDK retries cannot bypass policy; ambiguous outcomes remain uncertain.
cases.validation: Fault injection and SDK/adapter configuration review.
cases.evidence_required: Retry timing/attempt limits and no-hidden-retry evidence.

cases.title: OAuth, account binding and disconnect
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: An account-scoped connection exists.
cases.when: Exercise invalid/replayed callback state, refresh races, revoked credentials, disconnect and reconnect to another account.
cases.then: Unsupported callbacks rejected; tokens server-side; late refresh cannot resurrect disconnected credentials; no silent retargeting; local disconnect does not claim provider grant revocation or call broad revokeSignInSessions.
cases.validation: OAuth/connection tests and disposable account flow.
cases.evidence_required: Connection-generation/state results, safe scope disclosure and secret absence.

cases.title: Revocation and erasure race
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: An export is queued or in-flight and source/account can be erased.
cases.when: Commit revocation/erasure before dispatch and again after dispatch, then release a late provider result.
cases.then: Pre-dispatch fences suppress sends; in-flight creation is not falsely cancelled; no late result restores erased title/activity; future work blocked; minimal suppression record only as policy permits.
cases.validation: Forced race ordering with erasure epochs.
cases.evidence_required: State/transmission/persistence assertions and external-copy disclosure.

cases.title: Restored outbox quarantine
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: An old backup contains credentials and queued/sending intents predating deletion or disconnect.
cases.when: Restore in isolation and attempt dispatch before reconciliation.
cases.then: Outbound work stays disabled/quarantined, credentials unusable; stale sending does not repost; incomplete deletion/consent history blocks reopening; only freshly authorized new work can proceed.
cases.evidence_required: Quarantine state, zero outbound calls and reconciliation decision.

cases.title: Receipt wording and external copies
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: An intent is queued, created, uncertain or later externally moved/deleted.
cases.when: Read the UI and erase local source data.
cases.then: 202 means queued, succeeded means creation established; neither means activity completed or still synchronized; user was told remote copy remains; no implicit delete/recreate.
cases.evidence_required: State labels, activity/report unchanged and no unapproved remote mutations.

cases.title: Optional due time and privacy
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: Due time may be enabled and payload/logging are instrumented.
cases.when: Test omitted due time, timezone change, DST gap/overlap and content canaries.
cases.then: Title-only default works; enabled time fields round-trip reviewed meaning or reject ambiguity; no surprise reminders; logs omit title/token/private content; only approved remote fields leave.
cases.evidence_required: Timezone cases and captured allowlist/canary proof.

cases.title: Actual provider and release evidence
cases.applies_when: G6a scopes bounded implementation; G6b gates user enablement. Default integration deferred/disabled.
cases.given: Offline checks pass and one disposable external account/task test is authorized.
cases.when: Create/reconcile the reviewed fictional task, inspect actual permissions, disconnect and perform authorized fixture cleanup.
cases.then: Real provider behavior matches the contract or feature stays off; fake/live evidence separated; actual adapter/schema/deployment identified; rollback disables dispatch without replay.
cases.validation: Scoped real-provider smoke and release review.
cases.evidence_required: Exact candidate/provider test, remote fixture receipt, cleanup and rollback record.

cases.title: Current case study and operational package
cases.given: Applicable release/pilot evidence exists or is explicitly blocked.
cases.when: Prepare the current overview,90-second demo,guide,runbook and evidence matrix.
cases.then: All claims trace to exact build/data/denominator; unfinished gates visible; historical evidence separate; no private content; no invented user/time-saved/clinical metrics.
cases.evidence_required: Published-ready drafts, source links and release-evidence record.

cases.title: Personal ownership demonstration
cases.given: Yusen has participated in a meaningful implementation slice.
cases.when: Explain one request path and defect fix in five minutes, then make a small controlled variation and describe verification.
cases.then: Explanation covers owner/consent/state/provider/error boundaries and the actual change; AI-assisted work is described accurately; a recording/script alone is not proof of code ownership.
cases.validation: Actual walkthrough and small local exercise.
cases.evidence_required: Concise self-record/reviewer notes, explained diff and observed exercise result.
